## Requirements: GitHub-owned terminal release configuration and 96-column default

Follow-up product decision to completed #2487 (2026-10-28). The previous 80-column default was intentionally selected for narrow mobile readability, but the product owner has now explicitly selected **96 columns**. Keep fixed-column Session ownership, device font-fitting, ControlLease/resize ordering and existing Session compatibility unchanged.

### Configuration contract
- GitHub **repository Actions Variables** are the release configuration source: `NESSION_TERMINAL_COLS` and `NESSION_TERMINAL_WEB_FONT_SIZE`; no STAGING_/PRODUCTION_-specific terminal overrides. Release workflow resolves each once, validates, and supplies the same values to Web (Vite), Server and Agent artifacts. Web font default remains 14 CSS px.
- With no GitHub Variable, the approved fallback is **96 cols** (not 80) in Web, Server/Agent, Dockerfiles, Compose and release workflows; retain local standalone/development fallback.
- The runtime image carries its build-selected configuration. A deploy must not silently override a Web bundle with different Server/Agent columns. Record configuration+artifact identity in provenance; changing GitHub Variables alone does not change prebuilt artifacts and must not mutate existing Sessions.
- Existing Sessions retain pane-authoritative columns on attach and are not resized to 96. A 96-column grid on a narrow phone may hit the 6px font floor and horizontally scroll, as explicitly supported by #2487.
- Local Compose build args must carry the same values into Vite and Docker ENV as runtime environment, avoiding 96-server/80-web mismatches.

### Prototype
- Decision: Not needed (the fixed-column interactive sizing simulator already exists at https://bestnathan.github.io/nession/prototypes/terminal-fixed-cols-2487/index.html; this changes a selected default and build pipeline, not the interaction model).
- Fidelity / verification: Existing simulator is visual design evidence, not live xterm/PTY acceptance; verify 96-column mobile overflow and runtime pane geometry separately.

### Success Criteria
- [ ] SC-01 One shared GitHub variable source selects release columns/font cap for staging and production; absent cols defaults to 96, with no environment-specific variable precedence.
- [x] SC-02 Web client, Server, Agent and Docker/Compose default-build paths use 96 columns consistently; valid overrides still work and invalid values fail.
- [x] SC-03 A preexisting Session retains its authoritative width on attach after changing the release defaults; 96-column narrow-mobile fallback remains deterministic.
- [x] SC-04 A release build emits auditable config and artifact identity, and Compose cannot silently build a mismatched Web vs Server/Agent configuration.
